item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The figure shows Nitya's garden plot: rectangle ABCD is $6\ \mathrm{cm}$ by $4\ \mathrm{cm}$, and right triangle AEB has base $6\ \mathrm{cm}$ and height $3\ \mathrm{cm}$ on top of the rectangle.

How should she find the area of the figure?

options.A: Add the rectangle area $6 \times 4$ and the triangle area $\frac{1}{2} \times 6 \times 3$.
options.B: Use only the rectangle area $6 \times 4$, because the triangle sits on the rectangle.
options.C: The triangle area produces the rectangle area, so multiply those two part areas.
options.D: Any closed garden plot has area $6 \times 4$.
